hooks.name: Geofence engine purity guard
hooks.description: When the agent edits the skeleton's core logic, remind it that core stays pure and DOM-free and that rule changes need unit tests.

action.prompt: You just edited template/src/core. Keep it pure TypeScript: no DOM, no React, no timers, no storage, and never mutate an input state (return a new one plus events). Any change to unlock, ordering, dwell, hysteresis or smoothing rules needs a matching unit test in template/test and an update to .kiro/specs/haunt-kit-skeleton/requirements.md if behavior changed. Run `npm run check`.
